issues.tldr: Heavy news cycle: three critical vulnerabilities under active exploitation (Zyxel GS1900 zero-day, Cisco's "Node2Shell" Brotli bug, a Barracuda ESG root chain), major breaches at blockchain-intel firm Chainalysis and French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa (~$133M), plus a Russian APT29 mobile spyware campaign. AI platforms and AI-offensive tooling are a recurring thread through both the incident list and the emerging threats below.
